As I anticipate a bright and promising future for myself, I have decided to blog about my weight lose journey on my platform. Understanding how the pandemic has caused a fair share of weight gain for many people, I decided to use positive self-talk to get me through this process and make it last longer than a temporary fix. I simply want to spread positivity, positivity and of course lose 25 pounds that has been holding me back from accomplishing my life goals. Keep on reading my posts for many valuable lessons ahead. Best of luck to everyone on their weight loss journey.
